premises_address.label: Property / Premises Address
premises_address.ai_match_reasoning: Source is internally inconsistent on the floor: Section 1(a) states "Second Floor" (Lantai Dua) while Section 1(c) and the attached tenant floor plan ("TENANT CITOS FF LANTAI 1 (SATU)") both state "First Floor". Floor plan treated as authoritative; not resolved by assumption.

lessor_npwp.ai_match_reasoning: Not stated in the source tracker. The Faktur Pajak does print the seller NPWP 0018240572062000, but that is FP-side data and is not carried back into the contract record.

customer_name.ai_match_reasoning: Invoice prints "PT. BUMI BERKAH BOGA, KOPI KENANGAN" and the FP "BUMI BERKAH BOGA" — both variants of this same entity.

actual_start.label: Lease Commencement Date
actual_start.ai_match_reasoning: 16-Oct-2024, defined in the source as the first date of commercial opening rather than a separately stated handover date.

base_rent_monthly_excl_tax.label: Base Rent (Excl Tax) Monthly
base_rent_monthly_excl_tax.ai_match_reasoning: Rp630,000/m²/month x 19.46 m² = Rp12,259,800/month excl. VAT.

total_contract_value.label: Total Contract Value, Lumpsum
total_contract_value.ai_match_reasoning: Rp12,259,800 x 36 months = Rp441,352,800 excl. VAT. Reconciles exactly with the payment schedule's own rent TOTAL row.

base_fee.label: Monthly Rent
base_fee.ai_match_reasoning: Same figure as Base Rent: a flat rate-per-area lease with no escalation, so there is no separate monthly rent concept.

rent_billing_day.label: Rent Billing Day
rent_billing_day.ai_match_reasoning: Not explicitly specified for the Rental installments; the Service Charge is billed monthly in advance per Section 3b, but no day-of-month is stated for either.

escalation_rate.label: Escalation Clause (%)
escalation_rate.ai_match_reasoning: Not specified — the Rp630,000/m²/month rate appears fixed for the full 3-year term.

escalation_frequency.label: Escalation Frequency
escalation_frequency.ai_match_reasoning: Source cell is empty/zero, which in this tracker means not stated rather than zero.

escalation_starts_after_months.label: Escalation Starts After (months)
escalation_starts_after_months.ai_match_reasoning: Source cell is empty/zero, which in this tracker means not stated rather than zero.

utilities_billing.label: Utilities Billing
utilities_billing.ai_match_reasoning: No Rp consumption rate is stated anywhere in the offer letter, so the electricity and water invoices have no contract figure to compare against and are matched against their own calculation sheets instead (see the supporting documents).

wht_applicable.label: WHT Applicable
wht_applicable.ai_match_reasoning: Recorded as "Not stated" in the source tracker — the offer letter says nothing about withholding tax either way. Shown as NA. Bill Posting treats this vendor as not subject to WHT (bill_posting.json's own wht_applicable is false), so the WHT column preselects "00 · NO WITHHOLDING".

wht_rate_pct.label: WHT Rate (%)
wht_rate_pct.ai_match_reasoning: Recorded as "Not stated" in the source tracker — no WHT rate appears anywhere in the offer letter. Shown as NA rather than 0%, which would assert a rate the document does not state.

registration_number.label: Registration Number
registration_number.ai_match_reasoning: Offer stage — no number issued yet. The prior/expiring contract No. 0000002433 is referenced.

notice_period_days.label: Notice Period (Days)
notice_period_days.ai_match_reasoning: Source cell is empty — no standalone termination-notice period is stated in this offer letter.

computed_status.label: Computed Status
computed_status.ai_match_reasoning: The Tenant's signature block in the source scan is blank, so it is unclear whether this renewal offer was ever formally countersigned. Verify against the executed lease before relying on the status.
